residual_risks: Some prior results may be expressed in polymer writhe, stochastic area, or quadratic edge-permutation statistics under different names.

value.rationale: The fixed-edge area variance is a nontrivial invariant of edge anisotropy with exact equality cases; its Haar–Stiefel specialization yields the full all-size rational variance, the nonmonotone four-edge maximum, and asymptotic decay. It characterizes a natural signed geometric statistic beyond the already studied squared chords and triangle special case.
